description: Stepper for values <input type="number"> + data-stepper cannot reach: formatted units, currency, time, token-snap scales, discrete enums. Renders an inner role="spinbutton" that receives the host's label.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Current value (string). Authored value is the form-reset target; changes are reflected

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form field name for form participation

attributes.name: data-values
attributes.description: Token-snap mode: comma-separated list of values

attributes.name: data-options
attributes.description: Enum mode: JSON [{value,label}] array or csv shorthand (value==label)

attributes.name: data-format
attributes.description: Formatted mode: number | currency | percent | duration | bytes

attributes.name: data-currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 code, used when data-format="currency" (default USD)

attributes.name: data-suffix
attributes.description: Static suffix appended to display, e.g. "px"

attributes.name: data-show-label
attributes.description: Token mode: display the token name (strips leading --)

attributes.name: data-accelerate
attributes.description: Enable long-press acceleration on the +/- buttons

attributes.name: data-label-decrease
attributes.description: Accessible name of the decrease button

attributes.name: data-label-increase
attributes.description: Accessible name of the increase button

attributes.name: aria-label
attributes.description: Forwarded to the inner role="spinbutton" (prefer a <label for>)

attributes.name: aria-labelledby
attributes.description: Forwarded to the inner role="spinbutton", merged with any <label for> / wrapping <label>

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables stepping and removes the spinbutton from the tab order. A disabled <fieldset> does the same

attributes.name: readonly
attributes.description: Value cannot change: spinbutton gets aria-readonly, +/- buttons are disabled

events.name: input
events.description: Fires on every value change. Bubbles.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Current canonical value (number as string, token, or enum value). Setting it fires input + change

properties.name: displayText
properties.description: The user-visible formatted text, e.g. "$5.00", "2.05 KB", "Medium"

methods.name: recomputeWidth()
methods.description: Rebuild the width reserve after changing data-min/-max/-values/-options/-format after upgrade

states.name: at-min
states.description: Value is at the lower bound

states.name: at-max
states.description: Value is at the upper bound
